about: Thresholds for the lane check, one entry per question class. Every threshold is null until a person sets it and puts their name in set_by: with nothing set, every answer lands in the ask band and nothing acts on its own (Decision Gate D4). act_at and block_at compare against the answer's number: for a noul, the probability of yes; for a choice, the confidence in the chosen option. A null block_at means the class has no block band. Copy this file, set values, and pass it with --policy. `calibrate` reports where your rulings say the cuts would agree with you.

lane_status.does_not_authorize: merging, deploying, publishing or naming anything; finished only lets the coordinator move on

ask_met.does_not_authorize: changing an ask's recorded status; the witness keeps the ledger

claims_finished.does_not_authorize: anything; it is read beside lane_status to show a done claim without evidence

asks_person.does_not_authorize: answering for the person; a question to William goes to William
